title: Bourke Court House
scope: The standing Bourke Court House first opened for court use in 1901, including the raised courtroom, open turret, flanking pavilions and courtyard.
limitations: The old photographs record the architectural form and the heritage register records later restoration. Roof pitches, small rear volumes and brick and render colors are estimates.
The national elevation source resolves broad grade. Individual steps and courtyard paving levels are estimated.
